'''Gall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the sheriff of the [[Landing]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Engebo V]]. A former miner employed by [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]], he lost an eye in a mining accident for which he was given a huge compensation and the position of security chief at the ORO mines. When ORO pulled out of the Engebo V mines, Gall accepted a position with [[Jaffro Davengatt]], leading the security team that protected Davengatt's [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] ranches. Gall was one of the few beings to escape Engebo V, after the ''[[Madman's Fortune]]'' crashed onto the planet and released a swarm of [[skekfish]].
